chars.AYOUB: AYOUB: a 26-year-old young man wearing an oversized mustard-yellow hoodie with white drawstrings, black jogger trousers and white sneakers.
chars.SAMIR: SAMIR: a young studio sound engineer wearing a plain black t-shirt, grey ripped jeans and big black headphones around his neck.
chars.FATHER: FATHER: a middle-aged man wearing a beige Moroccan djellaba with a hood and brown leather slippers.
chars.MOTHER: MOTHER: a middle-aged woman wearing a dark green Moroccan djellaba and a light cream headscarf.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: A small home recording studio in Casablanca with foam panels on the walls. AYOUB stands nervously behind a microphone in a vocal booth behind glass, embarrassed, while SAMIR sits at a mixing desk outside the glass laughing out loud, holding his belly.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Night street in a Casablanca neighbourhood with old white buildings and street lamps. AYOUB walks home alone with his head down and hands in his hoodie pocket, sad and ashamed.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: A small dark Moroccan bedroom with closed curtains, a notebook and a pen on the floor. AYOUB sits on his bed hugging his knees, staring at the floor, depressed, the room lit only by thin light from the window.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: A Moroccan apartment hallway. The MOTHER stands at AYOUB's half-open bedroom door looking worried, while AYOUB lies on his bed turned away from her with a blanket.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: A Moroccan living room with low sedari sofas and a mint tea tray. The FATHER kindly hands a few banknotes to AYOUB, who takes them shyly, looking down.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: A small Moroccan bedroom during the day. AYOUB lies on his bed scrolling videos on his phone, bored, the phone screen glowing on his face.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: A small Moroccan bedroom at night. AYOUB sits at a desk in front of an open laptop, leaning his cheek on his hand, disappointed and tired, an empty glass of tea next to the laptop. The laptop screen faces away from the viewer.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: A small Moroccan bedroom at night. AYOUB jumps up from his chair in shock in front of his laptop, eyes wide and mouth open, both hands on his head, surprised. The laptop screen faces away from the viewer and glows.
